narrative.title: Typical vs trauma heavy
narrative.summary: Compared with Typical, Trauma heavy produces higher synthetic task pressure (+112 tasks) with a trauma workload notice in the warning signal set. The same comparison shows more deferred synthetic work (+77 tasks), higher approximate walking load (+7100 feet), and a larger queue-depth signal (+4). This is an operational comparison only and stays limited to deterministic Plan 1 demo evidence.
limitations: Synthetic tasks use explicit assumptions and seeded generation.
nonClaims: Not based on real patient, staff, EHR, or hospital data.
